model.expr: sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job="call-center-api", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[5m]) * on (job, instance) group_left(deployment_environment) max by (job, instance, deployment_environment) (target_info{job="call-center-api", deployment_environment="development"})) / sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job="call-center-api"}[5m]) * on (job, instance) group_left(deployment_environment) max by (job, instance, deployment_environment) (target_info{job="call-center-api", deployment_environment="development"}))

annotations.summary: call-center-api 5xx error rate above 5% on development
annotations.description: Fires when the share of call-center-api requests on development answered with a 5xx status exceeds 5% over 5m, sustained for 10m. Idle development (no requests) yields no data, which maps to OK. Sourced from OTel metrics joined to target_info on deployment_environment, the same join as observability/grafana-dashboard.json.
